description_en: Lists all traffic lane groups in a Service Mesh (ASM) instance
description_zh: 调用GetSwimLaneGroupList获取网格实例下所有泳道组列表
name: GetSwimLaneGroupList

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Service Mesh (ASM) instance
parameters.name: service_mesh_id

SwimLaneGroupList.description_en: A list of traffic lane groups

items.description_en: The details of a traffic lane group

FallbackTarget.description_en: The name of the baseline traffic lane for the traffic lane group. This parameter applies only if the group is in loose mode (`IsPermissive` is `true`)
FallbackTarget.description_zh: 宽松模式泳道组的基线泳道名称。仅在泳道组为宽松模式时，设置此参数有效

GroupName.description_en: The name of the traffic lane group

IngressGatewayName.description_en: The name of the ASM gateway

IngressRoutingStrategy.description_en:
The policy for shifting traffic to different traffic lanes within the traffic lane group. Valid values:

`weighted`: A policy that distributes traffic based on weights. A single rule matches requests, and the policy then distributes matched requests to different traffic lanes based on specified proportions.

`rule-based`: A policy that routes traffic based on specific rules. Each traffic lane has a unique matching rule, and a request is routed to a lane only if it matches that lane's rule
IngressRoutingStrategy.description_zh:
为泳道组内的多个泳道进行请求引流的策略，有两种可能取值：
weighted：基于权重的引流策略，即首先以统一的规则对请求进行匹配，对匹配到的请求进行引流，引流时，按照给定的比例将所有请求发往不同的泳道。
rule-based：基于规则的引流策略，即泳道组中的每条泳道都拥有自己的匹配规则，只有匹配到泳道对应的引流规则的请求才会被转发到对应的泳道

IngressType.description_en: The type of ingress gateway. Only ASM gateways support traffic shifting. The value must be `ASM`
IngressType.description_zh: 引流规则目前仅支持在ASM网关下进行配置

IsPermissive.description_en: Specifies whether the traffic lane group is in loose mode
IsPermissive.description_zh: 流量泳道组是否是宽松模式

RouteHeader.description_en: The request header for traffic shifting when the traffic lane group is in loose mode
RouteHeader.description_zh: 宽松模式流量泳道组的引流请求头

ServiceLevelFallbackTarget.description_en: Specifies a fallback version for each service. This setting overrides the group-level fallback policy
ServiceLevelFallbackTarget.description_zh: 服务级别 fallback 目标，为服务分别指定需要 fallback 的版本，这将覆盖泳道级别的 fallback 策略

ServiceList.description_en: A serialized JSON string that lists the services associated with the traffic lane group
ServiceList.description_zh: 泳道组关联的服务列表

SwimLaneLabels.description_en: A serialized JSON string. Each key represents a label key that is common to all services in the traffic lane group. The corresponding value is an array of all possible values for that label key
SwimLaneLabels.description_zh: 一个序列化后的JSON字符串，其中JSON对象的键为泳道组中所有服务都拥有的标签的键，JSON对象的值为该标签下泳道组内服务的所有可能的标签值数组

TraceHeader.description_en: The request header for trace pass-through in a traffic lane group that is in loose mode
TraceHeader.description_zh: 宽松模式泳道组的链路透传请求头

WeightedIngressRule.description_en: The traffic shifting rule for the entire traffic lane group. This parameter applies only when the traffic shifting policy is `weighted`
WeightedIngressRule.description_zh: 当泳道组的引流策略为weighted时可以设定。作用于整个泳道组的引流规则，
